units.note: All coordinates in pyxl units. 1 pyxl = 10px render. Torso-local origin = navelpoint (root / waist junction).

navelpoint.note: Root / waist junction. Torso origin. Attaches to waistpiece below.

vpoint.note: V of the neck / top of torso. Neckpiece vpoint plugs in here, recessed into torso.

collarpoint.note: Collar / neck attachment. = vpoint in single-piece collar variant. Future split-collar pivot.

left_shoulderpoint.note: Left shoulder brad. 0.75 heads from center (1.5 heads total span). Vitruvian proportion.

right_shoulderpoint.note: Right shoulder brad. 0.75 heads from center (1.5 heads total span). Vitruvian proportion.

left_collarpoint.note: Left collar anchor. Mates with neckpiece width (9 pyxl top).

right_collarpoint.note: Right collar anchor. Mates with neckpiece width (9 pyxl top).

shapes.note: Torso / collar piece. Shoulders 37.5w (1.5 heads), navel 29w. Height 49.5 pyxl (1.5 heads). Single-piece collar variant.

neck.note: Neckpiece vpoint plugs into torsopiece vpoint/collarpoint, recessed into torso body.

head.note: Head falls on top via neckpiece. Default pivot = V of neck.

collarpoint.note: Collar / neck attachment. Future split point for dual-collar variant.

collar.note: v1 = single rigid collar piece. Future: split at bottom center with rotation hinge.

segmentation.note: v1 = single torso piece shoulders-to-navel. Supports future chest/waist split.

meta.derived_from: Bitruvian-Posyng-Puppyt ANATOMY constants, Vitruvian shoulder proportions (1.5 heads total span)
meta.changelog: v3: Torso height 49.5 pyxl (1.5 heads) per Pyxl rounding rules. Was 46 pyxl / 1.4 heads in v2. Navel width scaled proportionally: 29w (was 27w). Torso side length: 53 pyxl (was 49.75). All coordinates follow Pyxl rounding: .01-.35→down, .35-.64→.5, .65+→up.
